title: Answer: qualia are an octonionic projection onto a torsion field in the body

statements.text: Experience is linked to the 9D source through the eight-dimensional octonion algebra. Qualia are the geometric reflection of the octonionic projection on a liquid-crystal torsion field of the biological anchor.

sources.quote: Qualia is defined as the geometric reflection of the Octonionic Projection upon the {H}_3{O}_2 (Liquid Crystal) Torsion Field of the biological anchor.
